digest.component_or_area: Jira cloud summary write and primary-store observation
propositions: Cloud summary write invocation must launch exactly one ACLI process with preserved process-group and child cleanup
Summary recovery performs one REST request with one-attempt no-sleep policy while all other REST callers retain three attempts with 2s/5s backoff
Retry policy must thread from _rest_urlopen_with_retry through _direct_rest_get to get_issue_by_rest as optional per-call arguments with unchanged defaults for unrelated consumers
Permanent failures (auth, TLS, permission, invalid requests) and transient failures (network, 429, retryable 5xx) must classify deterministically without adapter replay

Each terminal or exhausted outcome emits exactly one completion log with logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points (whole log at most 1,024)
Operation diagnostics collection holds at most eight entries with every message redacted before 512 Unicode code point cap
